feature: explicit work-request to one-off task conversion
rules: A request creates no task or KPI change until the manager confirms conversion.
Only an active manager can convert an unresolved work request; technical errors and suggestions cannot be converted.
The manager explicitly selects assignee, company, one-time date, checklist, task type, and positive weight.
The selected assignee must be active, visible to the manager, and authorized for the selected company.
A closed period, invalid date, missing materialized task, repeat schedule, or existing conversion rejects the operation without saving partial state.
The request and resulting task store reciprocal identifiers; conversion resolves the request and records the actor and time.
The assignee receives the existing in-app assignment notification, and authorized task readers see the source request context.

assertions: request creation does not create a task
manager assigns one task with selected assignee, company, date and weight
result is one-off and linked once to the source request
task detail retains source request context

buildNotes: The production JavaScript entry chunk is approximately 589 kB and triggers Vite's informational 500 kB warning.
Rollup removes two upstream Zod purity comments; the build succeeds.

limitations: Data stays in browser-local paris-state-lab and does not synchronize between computers.
No real customer information, attachments, account, API, D1, or Supabase is used.
This does not implement server-side authorization or notifications.
